_comment: UI metadata for realign, read by the command-center scanner. Today it carries only the TL;DR at the top of the strategy page: plain-English bullets whose {param} tokens the page fills with that setting's default, and whose show_if hides a bullet once its setting leaves the default. UI ONLY: it never touches a trade decision or the source hash. Click Scan Strategies after editing. Rules: command-center/backend/CLAUDE.md -> The TL;DR.

tldr.text: It waits for the 15-minute trend to flip, betting the flip is a trap; another break the same way cancels the idea.
The trigger: within {realign_window_hrs} hours, the 5-minute chart breaks against the trend, then shifts back with it.
It enters at market on that 5-minute close, aiming for the 15-minute swing before the trap, one trade at a time at {exec_risk_pct}% risk.
The stop sits {realign_sl_buf_tk} ticks past the pullback's extreme; halfway to the target it moves just past breakeven.
Nothing is banked early: at the target the stop lifts, then trails each new 15-minute swing.
It skips a trade that points the same way as gold's last {realign_mom_days} trading days.
A trade short of halfway after {exec_time_stop_hrs} hours is closed; a setup whose stop is under {exec_min_stop_val}% of price is skipped.

params.name: exec_risk_pct
params.label: Risk % per trade
params.desc: How much of the account each trade risks. The stop distance sets the position size, so a tighter stop buys a bigger position at the same risk.

params.name: realign_mom_days
params.label: Skip trades with the N-day move
params.desc: Refuses a trade that points the same way as price's move over the last N trading days, and any trade before N days of history exist. 0 turns it off.

params.name: realign_entry_mode
params.label: Entry timing
params.desc: When the order goes in once the setup fires: at market on the confirming bar's close, or as a limit waiting for price to come back and retest the break.

params.name: realign_retest_at
params.label: Retest price
params.desc: Where the retest limit rests: the structure level that broke (a setup with no known level is skipped), or halfway between the stop and the confirming close. Used only by the retest entry.

params.name: realign_retest_bars
params.label: Retest wait
params.desc: How long the retest limit waits before it is cancelled. 12 bars is one hour on the 5-minute chart. Used only by the retest entry.

params.name: realign_tp_r
params.label: Fixed take-profit
params.desc: Closes the whole trade at this multiple of its risk. Empty keeps the structure-based targets and trail.

params.name: realign_trail_frame
params.label: Trail frame
params.desc: Which chart's confirmed swings the trailing stop follows once the target is hit: the 15-minute trend chart (the design) or the 5-minute entry chart.

params.name: flat_mode
params.label: Flat before the close
params.desc: Closes any open trade shortly before the market shuts, so nothing is held through a break. Friday only covers the weekend and the holiday closes of the same shape; Every day also closes overnight. MEASURED 2020-2026 with costs charged: Off +82.41R, Friday only +58.34R, Every day +36.26R — and neither setting reduced the drawdown.

params.name: flat_by_close_min
params.label: ↳ Flat how many minutes before the close
params.desc: How far ahead of the close the position is given up. It must be larger than one bar, because the exit is a market order filled at the next bar's open — a shorter window could only fire on the session's last bar, after which there is no next bar until the market reopens. Read only when Flat before the close is on.

params.name: flat_holidays
params.label: ↳ Also flatten before holiday closes
params.desc: Covers the early closes and market holidays too — Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, the Thursday before Good Friday and Thanksgiving. Read only when Flat before the close is on.
